svg.aria-label: Constructed five-level calibration and low-calcium composite example, with three observations at each level and fixed random noise. The three unknown injections give about 0.80052 mg/L. Panel C assumes complete calcium release into 50.00 mL digest from 0.2500 g dry material, followed by tenfold dilution, giving about 1601.04 mg/kg.
